name: Natural Temperature
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Caesius_Leo
description: Natural Temperature is a mod that overhauls the way biomes are placed in the world, creating a layout that more closely resembles Earth’s climate zones with cold biomes in the north and warm biomes in the south.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
